verdict.rationale: Pylon's assignment model gives admins 'full control of which customer issues your AI agent interacts with' (assign only specific issues, like a teammate), which implies an opt-in mechanism that could be used to keep AI agents off legal/cancellation/security topics, and rubrics/runbooks can encode process rules. However there's no explicit documented feature for tagging or blocklisting specific topics/categories as 'human-only' with a hard guarantee the agent will never act on them. Missing for 10: an explicit topic/category exclusion or human-only tagging feature, and evidence/testimony that the agent respects such exclusions without exception.
